original_card.first_experiment: Choose one current supplier obligation and trace whether its acceptance depends on an independent check.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Closing a current acceptance gap or proof obligation strengthens reliability even without changing kappa.
allowed_variations: Audit one named current condition using a new semantic counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Reporting the historical timing-only diagnostic as a new current acceptance bug.

actual_scope: One named current condition of the selected chain: the cross-stage owner-map binding. Does chain acceptance of the hosted template imply hosting.pooled_slots equals the frozen data/OWNERS.json.gz role list (times included) and hosting.owner_map_sha256 names that gzip? Executed end to end on the archived selected fixture: the smallest coherent-emitter counterexamples (an equal-width cross-time pooled-slot time swap; a wrong owner_map_sha256) run through the frozen post-emit stages audit, invoice, assembly, admission-controls, bit-supplier-controls, independent-t16 and verify_t16.py's final binding, with rejection-power controls (a checked roles field; a stale HOSTED.json hash).
scope_change_reason: The drawn cards uniform-transfer-audit and selected-stock-envelope matched recent claimed objects (PR 2273 completed the uniform-transfer object today; the one-stage stock object was claimed in discussion 1166 comment 18932014 and is under five open PRs), so the second-choice card was taken and refined to the unclaimed cross-stage owner-map binding gap that PR1959 recorded but did not execute. Recorded per the pair-collision rule.
existing_restriction_changed: PR1959 checked the binding inside its own verifier and asserted the gap from source text; this package executes the accepted counterexample through the complete frozen caller and the final binding.
bottleneck_link: Closing a concrete inherited acceptance obligation of the selected chain: the certified owner-window and invocation-time evidence applies to the frozen OWNERS map, and the accepted template's role-to-time column was bound to it by nothing. Reliability result; no kappa arithmetic is changed.
method: Trace the hypothesis through source, checker and complete caller; then the card's second method: one semantically invalid but superficially well-formed fixture per unchecked field, coherent re-emit, and rejection testing. Deterministic stdlib harness, EXPECTED.json replay.
stop_rule: Stop at the first complete-caller acceptance of a fixture failing the owner-map binding (recorded as the counterexample), or, if every fixture is rejected, at the recorded rejecting stage and line. Both rejection controls must fail at their intended lines (172 and 185).
evidence: verify.py/EXPECTED.json: F0 accepted and reproduces every archived selected receipt (normalized for two machine-dependent serialisations), final binding 20/20, link check passes. F1 (pooled slots 0 and 480, (stage 0, replica 0, helper 0) and (stage 0, replica 8, helper 0), both width 9, exchange times 0 and 1; every per-time width count preserved): accepted by all six frozen post-emit stages, final binding 20/20, receipt diffs limited to template_sha256 hash cascades, link check fails on exactly the two role times. F2 (owner_map_sha256 = 64 zeros): accepted, final binding 20/20, link check fails on the naming field. F3 (pooled slot port changed): rejected by audit at line 172. F4 (time swap with stale HOSTED.json hash): rejected by audit at line 185. Status PASS_SELECTED_OWNERMAP_BINDING_GAP.
